svg.text: How many pounds of sterling silver does a year of average income buy?
GNI per capita (Atlas, USD) ÷ silver price × 0.925, in avoirdupois pounds (453.6 g) per year · shared log scale
lb of sterling silver per year (log scale)
Data: World Bank Commodity Price Data (Pink Sheet), silver USD/troy oz; World Bank WDI NY.GNP.PCAP.CD (GNI per capita, Atlas method)
Same data as the grams-per-month chart × 12 ÷ 453.59237. Metal value only (no making charge); silver prices rounded to 0.1 USD by the source. No USSR income in USD; Russia from 1991, Poland from
